newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OLYMPICS-RUSSIAN PREMIER TO SEE OLYMPIC CHIEF IN SWITZERLAND.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-RUSSIAN PREMIER TO SEE OLYMPIC CHIEF IN SWITZERLAND.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will visit the headquarters of the International Olympic Committee in Lausanne on October 2, the IOC said on Wednesday.
An IOC spokeswoman said Chernomyrdin, constitutional stand-in for ailing President Boris Yeltsin, would be meeting the organisation's president Juan-Antonio Samaranch.
Diplomats said the agenda for their discussions was likely to include the candidature of St Petersburg, Russia's second city, for the 2004 Olympic Games.
Chernomyrdin chairs the committee of support for the city's Olympic bid. Moscow staged the 1980 Olympic Games.
